title: Maximum Number of Books You Can Take
goal: Take the most books from a contiguous shelf range while taking a strictly increasing positive count from left to right.
strategy: At an ending shelf, take its cap and step downward by one to the left. A stack of increasing books[i]-i finds where that arithmetic progression meets a smaller cap; DP reuses the optimal earlier segment there.
